references.text: The Lord shall be king forever and ever - both verses refer to God as king over Israel
The Lord his God is with him, and the royal shout sounds among them - God as king in Israel, with a similar motif concerning Jeshurun
Jeshurun grew fat and kicked - the same poetic name Jeshurun is used for Israel
It is not you they have rejected, but me they have rejected as their king - God as Israel's true king
Jeshurun whom I have chosen - the same poetic name for Israel, God as creator and chooser
The leaders of the tribes and all the assembly of Israel gathered together - the gathering of Israel's tribes and leaders
Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the children of Zion shout for joy over their King - God as Israel's king
